name: arcade-agent-monorepo
description: USDC-backed AI Gladiator game on Arc L1

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
